transfer.text_1.en: Allow sending Secret contents to this destination.
transfer.text_1.zh-CN: 允许将 Secret 内容写入此目标位置。

transfer.text_4.zh-CN: 集群级资源，无命名空间

transfer.text_5.zh-CN: 正在连接或加载命名空间…

transfer.text_12.en: Could not list namespaces. Enter an existing namespace manually.
transfer.text_12.zh-CN: 无法列出命名空间，请手动输入已有命名空间。

transfer.text_16.en: I checked the destination. Delete the reviewed source resources from:
transfer.text_16.zh-CN: 我已检查目标可用，允许删除以下位置中已审阅的源资源：

transfer.text_20.en: No source cleanup starts until every target is verified. Deletions check the reviewed source UID and version; finalizers are never removed.
transfer.text_20.zh-CN: 全部目标验证通过后才能清理源端；删除时再次核对源 UID 与版本，不强制移除 finalizer。

transfer.text_27.en: Server identity, status, ownership and generated addresses are removed from the copy. Volume data and external systems are not transferred.
transfer.text_27.zh-CN: 副本会清理服务器标识、状态、原归属及自动分配的地址。卷数据与外部系统不随资源转移。

transfer.text_31.en: Target name, permissions and server dry-run passed.
transfer.text_31.zh-CN: 目标名称、权限及服务端试运行检查通过。

transfer.text_32.en: Transfer ended. Any remaining source resources were retained.
transfer.text_32.zh-CN: 转移已结束，尚未清理的源资源已保留。

transfer.text_34.zh-CN: 改为操作上层工作负载

transfer.text_37.en: Workload readiness checks do not verify application traffic or external dependencies.
transfer.text_37.zh-CN: 工作负载就绪检查不验证业务流量或外部依赖。

transfer.text_38.en: Create and verify the destination first. Source deletion requires a separate confirmation.
transfer.text_38.zh-CN: 先创建并验证目标，再单独确认删除源资源。

transfer.text_39.zh-CN: 复制后保留所有源资源。

transfer.text_48.en: Wait for the running transfer operation to finish.
transfer.text_48.zh-CN: 请等待当前转移操作完成。

transfer.text_49.en: Connect to the target cluster first.

transfer.text_51.en: This resource does not support reading full objects.
transfer.text_51.zh-CN: 此资源不支持读取完整对象。

transfer.text_52.en: Cluster identities, generated resources and persistent storage require their own migration workflow.
transfer.text_52.zh-CN: 集群身份、自动生成的资源和持久化存储需要专门的迁移流程。

transfer.text_53.en: This resource has an owner. Transfer its owning workload instead of a controller-managed child.
transfer.text_53.zh-CN: 此资源由上层对象管理，请转移上层工作负载，不要直接转移子资源。

transfer.text_54.en: Cluster-generated authentication tokens cannot be transferred. Create credentials at the destination.
transfer.text_54.zh-CN: 不能转移集群生成的认证令牌，请在目标端生成凭据。

transfer.text_55.en: A Service without a selector relies on external endpoints. Transfer its endpoint configuration separately.
transfer.text_55.zh-CN: 不含 selector 的 Service 依赖外部端点，请单独迁移端点配置。

transfer.text_56.en: This StatefulSet provisions persistent volumes. Migrate its data and storage bindings separately.
transfer.text_56.zh-CN: 此 StatefulSet 会创建持久卷，请单独迁移数据与存储绑定。

transfer.text_57.en: API definitions require a dedicated migration workflow; transfer resource instances instead.
transfer.text_57.zh-CN: API 定义需要专门的迁移流程，此处可转移资源实例。

transfer.text_58.en: Use Create a new Job for Job executions. Transfer a CronJob template instead.
transfer.text_58.zh-CN: Job 执行请使用“创建新 Job”；配置转移可操作 CronJob 模板。

transfer.text_59.en: Choose a valid lowercase target resource name.
transfer.text_59.zh-CN: 请输入有效的目标名称，使用小写字母、数字、短横线或点。

transfer.text_62.en: Use Submit or Resubmit for Workflow runs; transfer a WorkflowTemplate instead.
transfer.text_62.zh-CN: 工作流执行请使用提交或重新提交，配置转移请操作 WorkflowTemplate。

transfer.text_63.en: This workload references persistent volumes. Migrate storage and its data separately before transferring the workload.
transfer.text_63.zh-CN: 此工作负载引用持久卷，请先完成存储与数据迁移。

transfer.text_65.en: Target workload is not ready yet. Check its status, then verify again.
transfer.text_65.zh-CN: 目标工作负载尚未就绪，请检查状态后重新验证。

transfer.text_66.en: Select at least one source resource to move; dependencies are copied only.
transfer.text_66.zh-CN: 请至少选择一个要移动的源资源；依赖项仅复制。

transfer.text_67.en: The selected source was replaced or has no UID. Refresh the resource list.
transfer.text_67.zh-CN: 所选源资源已被重建或缺少 UID，请刷新资源列表。

transfer.text_68.en: The source is being deleted or has no resource version.
transfer.text_68.zh-CN: 源资源正在删除或缺少资源版本。

transfer.text_69.en: The target cluster does not serve this exact API version and resource scope.
transfer.text_69.zh-CN: 目标集群不提供对应的 API 版本与资源范围。

transfer.text_70.en: Choose a target namespace for namespaced resources; cluster-scoped resources have no namespace.
transfer.text_70.zh-CN: 命名空间级资源需要选择目标命名空间，集群级资源没有命名空间。

transfer.text_72.en: The source and target are identical. Choose another location or target name.
transfer.text_72.zh-CN: 源与目标相同，请选择其他位置或修改目标名称。

transfer.text_73.en: Helm or GitOps manages this resource. The copy is independent; update the source configuration to prevent reconciliation.
transfer.text_73.zh-CN: 此资源由 Helm 或 GitOps 管理。副本独立存在，请同步调整源配置，避免被自动还原。

transfer.text_74.en: A target resource with this name already exists. Rename or skip it; existing resources are never overwritten.
transfer.text_74.zh-CN: 目标已有同名资源，请改名或跳过；不会覆盖已有资源。

transfer.text_75.en: Confirm sending Secret contents to the selected destination.
transfer.text_75.zh-CN: 请确认将 Secret 内容写入所选目标位置。

transfer.text_76.en: Source delete permission is required for a move.
transfer.text_76.zh-CN: 移动需要拥有源资源的删除权限。

transfer.text_77.en: Resolve the transfer checks before creating target resources.
transfer.text_77.zh-CN: 请先解决检查中的问题，再创建目标资源。

transfer.text_78.en: The create response has no UID. Inspect the target; source cleanup is blocked.
transfer.text_78.zh-CN: 创建响应缺少 UID，请检查目标；源端清理已阻止。

transfer.text_80.en: The target configuration changed after creation. Source cleanup is blocked.
transfer.text_80.zh-CN: 目标配置在创建后发生变化，已阻止清理源资源。

transfer.text_81.en: The target was replaced after creation. Source cleanup is blocked.
transfer.text_81.zh-CN: 目标在创建后被重建，已阻止清理源资源。

transfer.text_82.en: A copy must never delete source resources.
transfer.text_82.zh-CN: 复制操作不能删除源资源。

transfer.text_83.en: Every target must be created and verified before source cleanup.
transfer.text_83.zh-CN: 全部目标创建并验证通过后，才能清理源资源。

transfer.text_84.en: The reviewed source was deleted; a replacement now uses its name and was not touched.
transfer.text_84.zh-CN: 已审阅的源资源已删除；同名的新资源保持不变。

transfer.text_85.en: Deletion requested; waiting for the source to disappear. Finalizers are not removed.
transfer.text_85.zh-CN: 已请求删除，正在等待源资源消失；不会强制移除 finalizer。

transfer.text_86.en: Multiple source resources map to the same target name. Rename or skip one of them.
transfer.text_86.zh-CN: 多个源资源对应同一个目标名称，请改名或跳过其中一项。

transfer.text_87.en: An unrelated target already exists. It was not adopted or overwritten; source cleanup is blocked.
transfer.text_87.zh-CN: 目标已有其他资源，不会接管或覆盖；源端清理已阻止。

transfer.source_changed.en: Source %{target} changed after review. Keep both sides and start a fresh transfer review.
transfer.source_changed.zh-CN: 源资源 %{target} 在审阅后发生变化。已保留两端资源，请重新检查转移。

transfer.connection_changed.en: A transfer connection was disconnected or replaced. Keep the source and open a fresh transfer review.
transfer.connection_changed.zh-CN: 转移连接已断开或被替换。请保留源资源并重新审阅转移。
